jobs.description:

Jobomschrijving

As an HRBP your responsibilities are:

• Act as a main contact for employees and managers.

• Manage employee lifecycle activities, from onboarding through to internal changes and departures.
• Work with managers to address employee relations matters in a fair and timely way.
• Contribute to the delivery of HR initiatives that meet business needs.Payroll Administration: Responsible for payroll-related activities in Belgium, The Netherlands, and Luxembourg: provide all payroll mutations to external providers in a timely and accurate manner

A successful junior HRBP should have:

• Fluent in Dutch, French & English (both written and verbal)
• Strong administration skills

• Excellent knowledge of MS-Office, especially Excel

• Attention to detail, accurate and structured
• Proactive and full committed to all aspects of work
• Efficient, with capacity to manage tight deadlines and multi-tasking
• Ability to interact effectively with employees, line managers and external contacts
• Trustworthy with high standard of ethics, integrity and confidentiality

• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good professional command of English.
